description: This file defines a base activity class for Android applications, providing common setup including logging initialization. It extends FragmentActivity and sets up a logging chain with custom log wrappers.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base class for activities in Android that sets up common logging and lifecycle handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when activity is created; currently only calls super.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when activity is starting; it initializes logging.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging by establishing a log chain with a custom LogWrapper and logs a 'Ready' message.
